blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.
blocks.zh: 从事科学的代理人必须从其成果中选择信息性实验和理性,但大多数发现基准不能将这种技能与召回、未说明的评分规则或捷径政策分开。 我们引入了Openhagen Worlds, 一套由27个程序生成的环境(有些环境有有限的真理空间), 从经典的实验推理谜题到模拟的基于物理和化学, 在其中,一个特工在预算下进行实验, 并做出一个答案, 一个决定性的验证者对照隐藏的真理来检查。 每项观察都规定了完整的评分规则,178个难度等级中的每个等级都经过校准:只有在64个开发实例中,一个脚本甲骨文至少在0.75上成功,最多0.25上最强的可信非减值政策,以及每条门口快捷键最多0.35上才能被接受. 92个核心层次覆盖所有27个家庭,规模大,以培训小型模型;86个前沿突袭将15个发现世界延伸至更困难的问题,并在一个隐蔽的系统上进行了三个、五个和八个以上承诺阶段的运动。 在同一84起被扣留的边境案件中,每户家庭和跑者1起,DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在其默认推理努力中解决32个,每个呼叫16,384个令牌,57个最大努力,每个呼叫高达393,216个令牌(oracle:79);在8个阶段的竞选中,仍然保存最大的头室. 政策专家迭代给出了9B模式的微小收益:在经过培训的家庭上,其核心层面的成功率从0.090上升到0.148,部分是通过更好的行动形式实现的,GPQA Diamond上没有可察觉的损失. 主机服务使用核心级的预留实例。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made programmatic checks a central training signal for reasoning models [ 19 , 13 ] , and agents are now asked to do science: they are expected to choose informative experiments, take the results into account and commit to a conclusion.
For such agents an environment is only useful if its reward measures that skill.
The answer must be checked exactly against something the agent cannot look up, the conditions for success must be stated, no policy that skips the reasoning may score well, and the levels must stay hard as models improve.
blocks.zh:
以可核查的奖励加强学习使方案检查成为推理模型的中心培训信号[19,13],现在要求代理人做科学工作:他们要选择信息丰富的实验,考虑结果并承诺得出结论。
对这种代理人而言,只有当环境的奖励衡量这种技能时,环境才有用。
必须严格对照代理商无法看清的东西来检查答案,必须说明成功的条件,任何跳过推理的政策都不可能得分好,随着模型的改进,水平必须坚守到底.

blocks.en:
Existing discovery environments cover a wide range of science and have shown how far agents are from autonomous discovery ( Table 1 ).
To our knowledge, none of them admits a level only after showing that scripted policies which skip the reasoning stay below a fixed success rate on it, and none shows the agent the complete rule it is judged by: tolerances, partial credit and judge rubrics stay inside the evaluator.
Most end each episode with a single answer, and, to our knowledge, none chains several irrevocably committed answers on one hidden system, with later stages depending on earlier ones, so none tests whether an agent can carry its own conclusions through a campaign.
And on the easiest levels, frontier models can already approach the ceiling: on NewtonBench, reasoning models reach 70–100% symbolic accuracy in the easiest setting, while in the hardest only two of them exceed 6% [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
现有的发现环境涵盖广泛的科学范围,并表明物剂距离自主发现有多远(表1)。
据我们所知,他们中没有一个在表明其推理低于固定成功率的脚本政策之后才承认某一级别,也没有人向代理人表明它所判断的完整规则:容忍度、部分信用和评断额留在评估者内部。
每集的结尾都有一个单一的答案, 据我们所知,没有一个答案会把几个不可撤销的 承诺的答案锁在一个隐藏的系统上, 后面的阶段取决于之前的阶段, 所以没有一个测试一个特工是否能够通过一场运动 来传达自己的结论。
在最简单的层面上,前沿模型已经可以接近天花板:在牛顿奔驰上,推理模型在最简单的设定中达到了70-100%的象征精度,而最困难的只有其中两个超过了6%[50].

blocks.en:
To fill this gap we introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environment families with 178 calibrated difficulty levels ( Section 3 ).
Each family hides a truth, publishes its full scoring rule in every observation and verifies a committed answer exactly or within a published tolerance.
The families range from classic puzzles that isolate experimental reasoning, such as group testing and the counterfeit-coin problem, to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry.
Each level is admitted by a calibration gate: on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle must succeed on at least 0.75 of them, while the strongest plausible non-deductive policy may succeed on at most 0.25 and every gated shortcut on at most 0.35; we call a level that passes the gate calibrated .
The gate’s measurements also show what each family tests: with the oracle interpreting the readings, a fixed sequence of every allowed experiment solves 0.98–1.00 of core mechanism-discrimination development instances, where the difficulty lies in the analysis, but only 0.02–0.28 of rule-induction ones, where the experiments must be chosen ( Table 15 ).
The 92 levels of the core tier span all 27 families.
The 86 rungs of the frontier tier extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder single questions (H1–H3) and with long-horizon campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system (L1–L3).
Evaluation instances come from a key that is never distributed, and a hosted service plays them.
blocks.zh:
为了填补这一空白,我们引入了Openhagen Worlds,这是一套由27个程序生成的环境家庭组成的套房,有178个校准难度等级(第3节)。
每个家庭都隐藏着真相,在每一项观察中发表其完全的评分规则,并确切地或在公布的容忍范围内核实一个坚定的答案。
家族从隔离实验推理的经典谜题,如群体测试和假币问题,到模拟-基于物理和化学.
每个关卡都有一个校正门:在64个开发情况中,一个脚本甲骨文必须至少成功0.75个,而最强的可能非降级政策最多可能成功0.25个,每个入门的捷径最多0.35个;我们称之为通过校正门的关卡。
门的测量还显示每个家庭的测试:通过甲骨文解释读取,每个允许的实验的固定顺序可以解决0.98-1.00的核心机制歧视发展案例,其中困难在于分析,但规则引入案例只有0.02-0.28,必须选择实验(表15)。
核心等级的92级覆盖所有27个家庭。
前沿层级的86个跑道延长了15个发现世界的难度(H1-H3),在1个隐蔽系统(L1-L3)上进行了3个、5个和8个以上承诺阶段的长视距运动。
评价实例来自从未分发的钥匙,由托管服务播放。

blocks.en:
Openhagen Worlds was built first as a training ground for smaller models.
Its core tier is sized so that models of a few billion parameters find first successes and a learning signal, with the aim of shaping them into specialised scientific reasoners for narrow domains, where a small model trained for one kind of experiment can be cheaper and more reliable than a general one.
That a frontier model approaches saturation on this tier is therefore expected: the pilot model solves all 45 of its core instances, and Flash solves 0.93 of the core episodes it finishes, though 0.37 of its episodes end without a legal action because its turns are cut at the per-call token limit.
The frontier tier applies the same construction to harder rungs, admitted by the same gate.
A pilot with a stronger model at xhigh reasoning effort, below its “max” setting, solves most of that tier, and so does Flash at its maximum reasoning effort, so difficulty has to be a ladder that keeps climbing.
Probes on development instances show where it can climb: most longer campaigns admitted by the same gate hold the stronger model, while rungs that only add hidden structure do not ( Section 7.1 ).
blocks.zh:
Openhagen Worlds首先被建成为更小的模型的训练地.
它的核心层次是大小的,这样数十亿个参数的模型就能够找到最初的成功和学习信号,目的是将它们塑造成狭小领域的专门科学推理器,在那里,接受过一种实验训练的小型模型比一般的模型更便宜,更可靠.
因此,预计这一层级的前沿模型将接近饱和度:试点模型将解决其所有45个核心实例,而Flash则解决其完成的核心事件0.93起,尽管其0.37个事件结束时没有采取法律行动,因为它的转折被切断到每呼叫的信号极限.
边界等级将同一建筑适用于同一大门所承认较硬的地道。
一个在x高推理努力中具有更强模型的飞行员,在它的"最大"设置之下,解决了大部分的分层,而Flash在最大推理努力中也一样,因此难度必须是不断攀登的阶梯.
对开发案例的探测显示它可以攀爬到哪里:同一大门所允许的更长时间的运动持有更强的模型,而只增加隐藏结构的跑道则不会(第7.1节)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate scripted references, two locally run models built on open-weight Qwen models and a fast frontier model through its API on the withheld instances ( Section 6 ).
The core tier separates the local models from the oracle and approaches saturation for frontier models.
On its discovery worlds, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 0.58 of its episodes; most of the others end without a legal action because its turns are cut at the per-call token limit, and of the episodes it finishes it solves 0.93.
On the frontier tier, Flash solves 0.27–0.49 of its episodes on each of the five rungs H1–H3, L1 and L2, and 0.11 on the eight-stage campaigns (L3), where only a window of recent records stays visible; the oracle solves 0.91–0.94 on every rung. Qwen3.8-27B reaches 0.04–0.16 there.
Most failed episodes of both models end on a committed wrong answer rather than on malformed output; for Flash, whose thinking reaches its per-call limit of 16,384 tokens on 27% of frontier decisions, these endings do not separate reasoning errors from the budget, and episodes that end on a turn re-asked after the limit succeed on 0.18, against 0.69 for the others.
Its frontier numbers therefore measure reasoning under that budget, and much of the difficulty is a budget effect: on the o = 0 o=0 frontier instances, one per family and rung, Flash at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call solves 57 of 84, against 32 under the cap and 79 for the oracle ( Section 6 ).

The headroom that holds is therefore measured against the oracle, not against Flash’s capped rates: Flash at its maximum effort stays below the oracle over all rungs ( − 0.26 -0.26 [ − 0.36 -0.36 , − 0.18 -0.18 ]), in the eight-stage campaigns the stronger model solves 8 of 14 (oracle 13; − 0.36 -0.36 [ − 0.64 -0.64 , − 0.14 -0.14 ]) and Flash at its maximum effort 7 of 14, and development-instance probes find more headroom in the longer campaigns of Section 7 .

blocks.en:
Beyond aggregate scores, we analyse the episodes and train on the suite ( Sections 8 and 9 ).
Campaign accuracy falls stage by stage, and Flash runs about as many experiments as the 27B and succeeds far more often, under a larger per-call budget.
On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains on trained and held-out families, with no detectable regression in general reasoning on GPQA Diamond.
In a separate study on two laboratory families outside the suite ( Section 9.3 ), online reinforcement learning raises the same model’s success on held-out replication worlds from 0.221 to 0.721 in one training run, above Flash with the same tools at low and default reasoning effort (0.446 and 0.371) when Flash plays under the 9B’s per-turn and per-episode token caps; with up to 24,000 tokens per call, Flash stays well ahead on a broader benchmark of laboratory data analysis (0.849 against 0.605), and the registered checkpoint fails one of that benchmark’s registered guards. A run that splits its updates between replication and method-comparison worlds improves on both families.
To summarise, our contributions are as follows: • We present Openhagen Worlds, 27 calibrated, procedurally generated discovery environments (with finite truth spaces in some families; Appendix C ) with 178 difficulty levels in two tiers, each level admitted by a per-level calibration gate, with withheld evaluation instances, a hosted evaluation service and a public sample. • We characterise the calibration and difficulty of both tiers, showing that every level separates deduction from every gated non-deductive policy, and that a stronger model at xhigh reasoning effort solves most of the frontier tier but stays well below the oracle on its longest campaigns. • We evaluate a fast frontier model and locally run models built on open-weight Qwen models on the withheld instances, with a stronger frontier model in a pilot, and report success, failure modes, decisions, cost per episode and the effect of the per-call token budget. • Through episode analysis and two training studies, we show how campaign errors compound, that on-policy expert iteration gives modest gains that partly reach held-out families, and that online reinforcement learning on laboratory worlds raises a 9B model’s success on held-out worlds of its training family well above its starting point and above a fast frontier model held to the 9B’s token caps, while that model stays well ahead at a larger budget on broader laboratory analysis.
blocks.zh:
除了总分外,我们分析各集,并在套房上进行培训(第8和9节)。
运动精度逐个阶段下降,而Flash运行的实验量与27B一样多,并且以更大的按召预算更频繁地取得成功.
政策专家迭代给9B模式在受过培训的被扣留家庭上略有收益,在GPQA Diamond上的一般推理中没有可察觉的回归.
在对套房外的两个实验室家庭进行的一项单独研究(第9.3节)中,在线强化学习将同一模型在被搁置的复制世界上的成功率从0.221提高到了0.721,在Flash上方,在低和默认推理努力下使用同样的工具(0.446和0.371),当Flash在9B的每回和每回的代号帽下演奏时;每次呼叫高达24 000个代号,Flash在实验室数据分析的更广泛基准上保持了领先(0.849对0.605),而注册的检查站未能达到该基准的登记卫士之一。 在复制与方法比较世界之间划分更新的跑步对两个家庭都有改善.
概括而言,我们的贡献如下: 我们提出Openhagen Worlds, 27个校正、程序生成的发现环境(有些家庭有有限的真理空间;附录C),有178个难度等级,分为两个等级,每个等级由一个校正门接受,不设评价例,主办评价服务和公众抽样。 我们将两个等级的校正和难度定性,表明每个等级都从每个入门的非降级政策中分离出扣除,在x高推理努力中更强大的模式解决了大部分前沿等级,但在最长的竞选中却远远低于甲骨文. 我们评价一个快速前沿模型和本地运行模型,这些模型建立在被扣事例的开放式Quen模型上,在试点中有一个更强大的前沿模型,并报告成功、失败模式、决定、每集费用以及每集象征性预算的影响。 二. 支助 通过插曲分析和两次培训研究,我们展示了竞选失误的复杂程度,政策专家的迭接给部分被搁置家庭带来微小收益,并且实验室世界在线强化学习为其培训家庭的被搁置世界带来了9B模式的成功,远超其起点和9B标志帽的快速前沿模式,而这一模式在更广泛的实验室分析的更大预算上仍然领先。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Text and simulated worlds have long been used to evaluate agents that experiment.
ScienceWorld poses elementary-school science tasks in an interactive text environment [ 42 ] , and DiscoveryWorld asks agents to complete full discovery cycles across eight topics [ 17 ] .
BoxingGym scores experimental design by expected information gain and model discovery by whether an explanation lets a second agent predict [ 12 ] .
NewtonBench, PhysGym and DiscoverPhysics ask agents to recover physical laws from interactive experiments, often under shifted laws or withheld prior knowledge [ 50 , 5 , 44 ] .
These benchmarks measure valuable skills, but to our knowledge none admits a level only after showing that non-deductive policies stay below a fixed success rate on it (ScienceWorld reports a random-action baseline and NewtonBench a test without observed data, neither used to admit levels), and none tests campaigns in which committed answers must be carried across stages.
blocks.zh:
长期以来,文字和模拟世界被用来评估实验的代理人。
ScienceWorld在互动的文本环境中提出小学科学任务[42],并发现 世界要求代理商完成8个课题的全部发现周期[17].
BoxingGym通过预期的信息增益和模型发现来评分实验设计,通过解释是否让第二个代理预测[12].
牛顿奔驰、物理学和发现 物理要求物剂从交互实验中取回物理定律,通常在转移定律下取取,或者不预知[50,5,44].
这些基准衡量宝贵的技能,但据我们所知,在表明非减让性政策低于固定的成功率之后,没有一种标准才承认(科学世界报告随机行动基线,牛顿本奇报告测试没有观测到的数据,也没有用于承认水平),任何试验运动中承诺的答案都必须跨阶段进行。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of representative discovery and reasoning environments. Rows are grouped by their primary target. Experiments : the agent chooses its own experiments over several turns. Training : the work trains models on the environment. Gated levels : every level is admitted only after scripted non-deductive policies are shown to stay below a fixed success threshold on it. Campaigns : episodes that chain several separately and irrevocably committed sub-answers on one persistent hidden system under a pooled budget, later stages depending on earlier truths or commits. Entries for other works follow their published descriptions.
blocks.zh: 表1:代表性发现和推理环境比较. 各行按其主要目标分类. 实验:物剂自取实验取自于多转. 培训:工作培训环境模型。 Gated 级别:每个级别只有在脚本非降级政策显示其低于固定的成功门槛后才能被接纳. 运动:将若干次单独和不可撤销地对一个长期隐藏的系统进行子回答的事件,这些次回答是在集合预算下进行的,随后的阶段取决于先前的真相或承诺。 其他作品的条目遵循其已发表的描述.

blocks.en:
Procedural generation separates training from evaluation instances [ 7 ] , and Reasoning Gym applies it to verifiable reasoning tasks for reinforcement learning [ 40 ] . Xu et al. [45] build SciDisco, discovery environments with hidden evidence graphs, and train a 14B model with turn-level reinforcement learning; Kriz et al. [18] train the reasoning behind experiment choice with an information-gain reward; and Patel [26] finds that a forward computation distils into a student while a backtracking search procedure does not.
Openhagen Worlds generates every instance, so the same families can be trained on and withheld, and it pairs held-out families with named trained relatives to test transfer.
blocks.zh:
程序生成将培训与评价实例相分离[7],"理性健身"将其应用于可核查的推理任务以强化学习[40]. 许等. [45] 以隐藏的证据图表来构建SciDisco,发现环境,并训练出有转弯级强化学习的14B模型; Kriz等. [18] 将实验选择背后的推理训练成信息回报;而Patel [26] 发现前向计算可以向学生提炼而后向跟踪搜索程序则不会.
Openhagen Worlds 生成每一个实例,所以同样的家庭可以被训练并被扣留,它被搁置的家庭与被训练过的名字的亲属对接,以测试转移.

blocks.en:
Benchmark builders remove or rewrite items that partial-input baselines or adversarial filters solve without the intended reasoning [ 14 , 49 , 21 ] .
The calibration gate applies this idea per difficulty level, with scripted non-deductive policies in place of trained models.
A policy optimised against a reward can also satisfy it in unintended ways [ 1 , 38 ] , so every episode in Openhagen Worlds records the experiments it ran, and a training filter can check the route to an answer as well as the answer.
Canary strings let corpus builders exclude evaluation data [ 39 ] ; because a generator distributed for training would otherwise also generate the test, we combine them with a private key for the evaluation instances.
blocks.zh:
基准构建者删除或重写部分输入基线或对抗性过滤器解决的项目,而不按预期推理[14、49、21]。
校正门每个难度级都应用了这个想法,被脚本化的非降级政策取代了训练有素的模型.
对奖励进行优化的政策,也可以意外地满足它[1,38],所以在Openhagen的每一集 Worlds记录它进行的实验,一个训练过滤器可以检查一个答案和答案的路径.
加那利弦乐器制造器排除了评价数据[39];因为分配用于培训的生成器否则也会产生测试,所以我们把它们与用于评价的私人钥匙结合起来。

blocks.en:
Expert iteration, which began as imitation of a search expert [ 2 ] , and rejection-sampling fine-tuning train a model on its own verified or highest-reward samples [ 27 , 48 , 47 , 10 , 37 ] ; on-policy training typically forgets less than fine-tuning on another model’s outputs [ 35 , 4 ] , and, in controlled card-game and navigation tasks, reinforcement learning generalised further out of distribution than supervised fine-tuning [ 6 ] .
We apply this route to multi-turn agentic environments, with a capped share of teacher episodes rendered in the student’s own format.
Group-relative policy optimisation replaces a learned value function with the mean reward of several attempts at the same problem [ 34 , 23 ] ; we use it for online reinforcement learning on laboratory worlds.
blocks.zh:
专家迭代,开始模仿搜索专家[2],拒绝抽样微调在自行核实或最高奖励样本上对一个模型进行微调[27,48,47,10,37];政策性培训通常会忘记对另一个模型的输出进行微调[35,4],在受控的卡片游戏和导航任务中,强化学习比监督微调更普遍地超出分布范围[6].
我们把这条路线应用于多回合代理环境,以学生自己格式制作的教师节目的上限份额。
集团关系政策优化用对同一问题的若干尝试的中奖取而代之;我们用它进行实验室世界在线强化学习.

blocks.en: 3  Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3 基准建设

blocks.en: 3.1  Construction pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑管道

blocks.en:
Every family and level passes through the same four-stage pipeline ( Figure 1 ).
The stages are run by code, not by annotators: a family is a generator, a verifier, a set of scripted policies and a datasheet, and a level is admitted or rejected by the gate’s measurements alone.
blocks.zh:
每个家庭和级别都经过同一个四个阶段的管道(图1)。
各个阶段由代码管理,而不是由注释者管理:一个家庭是一个生成者,一个核查者,一组被脚本化的政策和一个数据表,一个关卡单靠大门的测量就可以被接受或拒绝.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The four-stage pipeline that admits every level of Openhagen Worlds. Stages 01 and 02 are built once per family; stages 03 and 04 run for every difficulty level, in both tiers.
blocks.zh: 图 1:四相管线,收录了"Openhagen World"的每个级别. 01和02阶段每个家庭建造一次;03和04阶段每个困难级别运行,分为两个阶段。

blocks.en:
A family’s generator draws a hidden system (a resistor network with a fault, a kinetic scheme, a causal graph with a confounder, a program with a bug) from its level’s settings.
The agent sees a public observation that is re-rendered every turn: the objective, the objects and their limits, the action grammar, the experiment budget and its use, the history of readings and the complete scoring rule, including every tolerance and every condition that ends the episode.
Nothing that decides success is left unstated.
blocks.zh:
一个家庭的生成器从它的级别设置中绘制出一个隐藏的系统(一个有缺陷的抵抗器网络,一个动能计划,一个有混乱者的因果图,一个有错误的程序).
特工看到一个每次转弯都会被重新交接的公开观察:目标,对象及其极限,动作语法,实验预算及其使用,读取历史和完整的分分规则,包括结束剧集的每一个容能和每个条件.
没有哪个能决定成功,

blocks.en:
The verifier scores a committed answer with reward 1 or 0.
Discrete answers must match exactly; answers with many spellings are scored by semantic equivalence (a rule over number triples on all 1,000 triples of its domain, a program fix by its output on every input, an automaton by behavioural equivalence, a molecule by constitutional identity); continuous answers have published tolerances; and design answers, such as a controller, a chromatographic method or a process, are verified by simulating them on the true system.
Identifiability filters reject instances whose required distinctions cannot be made with the allowed experiments, a failure Shetty and Braga-Neto [36] document in DiscoverPhysics [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh:
核查员以1或0的奖励来评分一个承诺的答案.
分明的答案必须精确匹配;与许多拼音的答案是用语义等同的来打分的(一个规则,对于其域上所有1000个三分数上的数字三分数,一个程序通过每个输入的输出来固定,一个通过行为等同的自发体,一个分子通过宪法身份来固定);连续的答案已经公布了容受性;设计答案,如控制器,色谱法或过程,通过在真实系统中模拟它们来验证.
可识别性过滤器拒绝在“发现物理”[44]中与允许的实验无法进行必要区分的失败Shetty和Braga-Neto[36]文档。

blocks.en:
The gate runs scripted policies that read only the public observation.
The oracle keeps the exact set of hypotheses consistent with the evidence, or a posterior over them, chooses the experiment that splits them best [ 3 ] and commits when one remains; it is an idealised reference, not a level models are expected to reach.
The naive policy is the strongest plausible non-deductive policy for the family, such as probing in a fixed order or regressing on observational data. Shortcut policies are specific habits that could pass for skill, such as measuring at both safety limits, plus an answer prior that commits another instance’s correct answer.
On the frontier tier the panel also includes the strategy that solves the next easier rung, a stage-by-stage policy that re-solves each stage of a campaign from scratch and, on the longest campaigns, an oracle without notes.
A level is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, the oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the naive policy on at most 0.25 and every shortcut on at most 0.35, and only if truths, oracle replays and instance digests are identical across processes.
The exhaustive design , where a family defines one, runs every allowed experiment in a fixed order and then applies the oracle’s analysis; it is reported, not gated, and shows whether a family tests the choice of experiments or only the analysis of evidence.
On the frontier tier, the other reported policies are likewise deductive: each applies the oracle’s exact analysis to a simpler design, such as the previous rung’s design, a design for the current stage only, or a fixed set of probes, and some succeed on more than 0.35 of development instances, which shows that the rung’s difficulty there lies in the analysis rather than in the design.
One reported habit is not deductive: on control plant’s long-horizon rungs, tuning the outer loop as if the inner loop were perfect succeeds on 0.44–0.72 of development instances, because a fast inner loop often makes it good enough, and it is reported rather than gated.
blocks.zh:
大门执行只读出公众观察的脚本政策.
甲骨文保持精确的一套假设与证据一致,或者在它们之上有一个后人,选择将它们分得最好的实验[3],并在一个被留下时承诺;这是一个理想化的参考,而不是预期会达到的水平模型.
幼稚的政策是家庭中最强有力的、可信的非贬低性的政策,如按固定顺序进行勘测或观察数据倒退。 快捷政策是技能可以流传的具体习惯,比如在两种安全限度下进行测量,加上在做出另一实例正确答案之前的答案。
在前沿层面,小组还包括解决下一个较简单的问题的战略,一种分阶段的政策,从零开始重新解决竞选的每个阶段,在最长的竞选中,一个没有注释的预告片。
只有当在64个发展实例中,神谕在0.75、最多0.25和最多0.35的每一个捷径上都取得了成功,并且只有在各个进程的真实性、神谕的回放和实例摘要完全相同的情况下,才能承认一个级别。
由家庭定义的详尽设计,按固定顺序进行每一个允许的实验,然后应用甲骨文的分析;它被报告,而不是被锁定,并显示一个家庭是测试实验的选择还是仅仅分析证据。
在前沿层面,其他所报告的政策同样是推论性的:每项政策都将甲骨文的确切分析应用到一个更简单的设计上,如前一跑道的设计,只用于目前阶段的设计,或一套固定的探测器,有些政策在超过0.35个发展实例上取得成功,这表明甲骨文的困难在于分析而不是设计。
据报道,一种习惯是不会被扣除的:在控制厂的长距离跑道上,对外环进行调整,仿佛内环在0.44–0.72个发展实例上是完美的,因为快的内环往往能使它足够好,而且它被报告而不是被锁定。

blocks.en:
Admitted levels form a family’s ladder.
An instance is a pure function of its family, split, level, index and key, so every episode can be replayed.
Training and development instances use separate keys, and the final instances come from a third key that is never distributed; every model plays the same ones, and all comparisons are paired. Generators, level settings and verifiers are chosen on development instances; the final instances informed the design of the frontier tier only, which was tuned against a screen of one model on them ( Sections 3.2 and 10 ).
The hosted evaluation service plays exactly the core tier’s final instances and reveals only the observation, reward, termination and success.
blocks.zh:
承认的等级构成家庭的阶梯。
一个实例是其家族的纯粹功能,分出,关卡,索引和密钥,所以每集都可以被重放.
培训和发展实例使用单独的密钥,最后实例来自从未分配的第三个密钥;每个模型都使用相同的密钥,所有比较都是对等的. 生成器、级别设置和核查器是按开发实例选择的;最后实例仅用于前沿层级的设计,而前沿层级则取材于其中的一个模型的屏幕(第3.2和10节)。
主办评价服务恰恰是核心层面的最后实例,只显示观察、奖励、终止和成功。

blocks.en:
One concern runs through every stage: a generator distributed for training must not also generate the test.
Beyond the private key, every distributed file carries a canary string and every observation an instance hash, famous instances (the twelve-coin puzzle, textbook rule-induction rules, named Bayesian networks and control plants) are excluded by construction, and a keyed filter rejects generated programs that match a protected program-execution benchmark ( Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
一个关切贯穿每个阶段:为培训分配的发电机不能产生测试。
在私人密钥之外,每个被分发的文件都带有金丝雀弦和每个观察实例散列,出名的例子(十二币谜题,教科书规则入门规则,命名为贝叶斯网络和控制厂)被建筑排除,一个被键入的过滤器拒绝生成的与受保护的程序执行基准(附录C)相匹配的程序.

blocks.en: 3.2  Families, tiers and splits
blocks.zh: 3.2 家庭、等级和拆分

blocks.en: Figure 2: The 27 families of Openhagen Worlds in four groups, and the two tiers. Every family has a core ladder; the 15 discovery worlds also carry the frontier tier of harder (H) and long-horizon (L) rungs. Table 13 lists what each family hides, its experiments and how its readings are computed. † held out of all training; ‡ two levels use an evaluation-only grammar.
blocks.zh: 图 2:Openhagen Worlds的27个家族分为四组,两档. 每个家族都有一个核心阶梯;这15个发现世界还承载了更硬(H)和长相线(L)的前沿阶梯. 表13列出了每个家庭隐藏的事物、其实验以及其读数如何计算。 · 在所有培训中进行;

blocks.en:
The 27 families form four groups ( Figure 2 ; Table 13 in Appendix B , where Table 14 also defines the terms used throughout).
The fifteen discovery worlds are the central families of the suite and the only ones with a frontier tier.
Four of them are classic puzzles of experimental reasoning (group testing, counterfeit coin, rule induction and automaton learning), and the others idealise laboratory and reasoning problems, from fault finding in circuits and kinetic models to causal inference and program repair; we treat all fifteen as tests of experimental reasoning rather than of domain science.
Two MicroWorld families test long exact computation and evidence auditing.
The simulator-grounded science of the suite is in its last ten families: five PhysicsWorld families wrap simulators (rigid-body dynamics, a panel method, ray transfer, modal and hydraulic models), and five ChemistryWorld families model spectroscopy, equilibria, kinetics, chromatography and voltammetry.
Each family has a datasheet that records what is hidden, the grammar and scoring rule, the difficulty settings, the calibration, the instance space, contamination notes and the simulator with its known limits.
Two laboratory families outside the suite, used to train and evaluate a model by reinforcement learning, are described in Section 9.3 .
blocks.zh:
27个家庭组成了四个组别(图2;附录B表13),表14也界定了整个用语。
15个发现世界是该套房的中心家族,是唯一具有前沿层次的.
其中四个是实验推理的经典谜题(团体测试,假币,规则诱导和自发性学习),而其他则将实验室和推理问题理想化,从线路和动力模型中的断层发现到因果推论和程序修复;我们把所有十五个都视为实验推理而不是域科学的测试.
两个MicroWorld家庭测试长期精确的计算和证据审计.
该套房的模拟-地基科学在它的后十个家族中:五个物理世界家庭包装模拟器(硬体动力学,一个面板方法,射线转移,模式和液压模型)和五个化学世界家庭模型分光学,等离子学,动力学,色谱学和电压学.
每个家族都有一个数据表,记录所隐藏的东西,语法和打分规则,难度设置,校正,实例空间,污染说明和有已知限制的模拟器.
第9.3节介绍了套房外的两个实验室家庭,这些家庭用来通过强化学习来训练和评价一个模型。

blocks.en:
Core levels, numbered d0, d1, … from the easiest, scale the size of the hypothesis space, the noise, the slack in the budget, the depth of the deduction or the length of the computation.
The discovery worlds have three core levels each, the MicroWorld families six, the PhysicsWorld families four and the ChemistryWorld families three: 92 levels in all.
Easier entry levels below them give small models their first successes during training and are not evaluated.
blocks.zh:
核心等分,编号为d0,d1. 从最简单的, 缩放假设空间的大小, 噪音, 预算的松懈, 扣除的深度或计算长度.
发现世界各有3个核心等级,分别是"微世界"家庭6个,"物理世界"家庭4个,"化学世界"家庭3个:共92个等级.
在培训期间,较轻松的入门水平提供了初步的成功模式,不加以评价。

blocks.en:
The frontier tier adds six rungs to each discovery world.
Harder rungs (H1–H3) are harder, not noisier: no rung raises the noise or tightens a tolerance relative to the family’s hardest core level.
Instead they enlarge or structure the hypothesis space or add an inference step the core levels never need, and each must defeat the strategy that solves the rung below it.
Long-horizon rungs (L1–L3) are campaigns : three, five and eight or more stages on one persistent hidden system, each closed by a committed answer, under a pooled experiment budget that is too small to re-solve every stage from scratch.
Later stages depend on earlier truths and in some families on the agent’s own earlier commits, such as its committed controller or patch, and an episode succeeds only if every stage is right.
L3 campaigns show only a window of recent records and give the agent a notebook, so it must decide what to write down.
Pooled over families, each ladder is graded, from an entry rung that a fast frontier model ( DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ) solves about half the time to upper rungs that it solves far less often. That grading was a design target: the tier was built after Flash’s results on the core tier, aiming for Flash success of about 0.10–0.40 at each family’s top rung, and the target was read from screens of Flash on final instances. Rung settings were chosen on development instances, and no rung setting, generator or verifier changed after any model played the final instances; after the first screen, however, the frontier families’ action parsers (a lenient second reading of a rejected reply), part of the campaign wording, the budget display of one family and the re-ask after a cut turn were revised, and the same final instances were played again.
Of the 90 possible rungs, 86 are built and admitted; pathway fault has only L1 and L3, and only its L1 is evaluated here.
blocks.zh:
前沿层为每个发现世界增加了6个径.
H1–H3更硬了,不是无声的:没有一丁点引起噪音,或者相对于家庭最困难的核心水平,收紧宽容。
相反,它们扩大或构建假说空间,或增加一个推论步骤,核心水平从来不需要,而每一个都必须击败解决其下方突起的战略.
长视距跑道(L1-L3)是运动:在一个持续隐藏的系统上进行三、五和八个以上阶段,每个阶段由一个承诺的回答结束,在一个集合实验预算下,这个预算太小,无法从头解决每个阶段。
之后的阶段取决于更早的真相,在有些家庭中则取决于代理人自己更早的承诺,如承诺控制器或补丁,只有每个阶段都正确,剧集才会成功.
L3运动只显示一扇最近记录的窗口,并给特工一个笔记本,所以它必须决定写下什么.
每个梯子都是分级的,从一个快速边疆模型(Deep Seek V4.1 Flash)能解决大约一半时间的入围跑到它能解决的更少的上行跑. 这一分级是一个设计目标:该分级是在Flash在核心分级结果后建立的,目标是Flash在每个家庭的顶级赛事上取得大约0.10-0.40分的成功,目标从Flash的屏幕上读取到最后的例子。 在开发实例中选择了rung设置,在任何模型播放最终实例后,没有运行设置、生成器或验证器改变;然而,在第一屏幕播放后,前沿家庭的行动解析器(对被拒绝的答复进行宽大二读),部分竞选措辞,一个家庭的预算显示和切入后重新任务被修改,并且再次播放同样的最终实例。
在90个可能的跑道中,86个是建造和承认的;路径断层只有L1和L3,这里只评估它的L1.

blocks.en:
Three discovery worlds are held out of all training, each with a close trained relative: mechanism discrimination (reaction network, hidden law), counterfeit coin (group testing) and automaton learning (rule induction, trace debugging); fluid network is held out among the PhysicsWorld families, and two exact-execution levels use a construction that no training level contains.
Final instances number 24 per family and level on both tiers (2,208 core instances).
blocks.zh:
在所有培训中,都举办了三个发现世界,每个发现世界都有一个受过训练的近亲:机制歧视(反应网络,隐藏法则),假币(团体测试)和自发马顿学习(规则诱导,痕量调试);流体网络在物理世界家族中被维持,两个精确的执行级别使用一个没有训练级别包含的构造.
最后案例为每家24个,两级为2 208个核心案例。

blocks.en:
An agent receives the public observation and takes one action per turn ( Figure 3 ): an experiment, a sandboxed Python analysis of the readings (in families that offer the tool), or a COMMIT, which submits the answer and, outside campaigns, ends the episode.
Actions are accepted as bare commands, JSON objects or tool calls, and equivalent spellings of a command are accepted, so that interface conventions are not what is measured.
A reply without a legal action is returned with the parser’s reason and the exact legal form and costs one turn, and two such replies in a row end the episode.
An experiment outside the safe limits or beyond the budget ends the episode at zero, as the observation states.
We call an episode that ends on replies without a legal action an invalid ending .

All 178 levels pass the gate ( Figure 4 ).
On the 92 core levels, the oracle succeeds on 0.80–1.00 of development instances, the naive policy on at most 0.19 and the strongest shortcut on at most 0.33; the ten PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld families also pass on a second independent block.
On the 86 frontier rungs, every rung passes on two blocks: the oracle succeeds on 0.78–1.00, the naive policy on at most 0.14, every gated shortcut on at most 0.31, and copying the grammar’s example answer on none.

Where it fails, the evidence has to be chosen: knockout network (0.05–0.17), rule induction (0.02–0.28), airfoil inference (0.03–0.12), coupled oscillators (0.00–0.16) and the optical bench (0.16–0.27) cannot be solved by running experiments in a fixed order.
Where it succeeds often, the bottleneck is the analysis: mechanism discrimination (0.98–1.00), chromatography method (0.75–0.92), electrochemical mechanism (0.69–1.00) and structure elucidation (0.64–0.91).
Families in between, such as heat inclusion (0.47–0.58) and reaction network (0.45–0.56), need both, and each datasheet reports where its family lies, so that a study of experiment choice can weight the families where the exhaustive design fails.

On the core tier’s 360 shared instances, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash succeeds on 0.583 and Qwen3.8-27B on 0.358, a resolved difference of + 0.225 +0.225 [ + 0.169 +0.169 , + 0.278 +0.278 ], against 0.978 for the oracle and 0.094 for Concise-9B ( Table 5 ).
Flash ends 0.37 of these episodes invalid, almost all on two turns in a row at its token limit; of the episodes it completes, it solves 0.925.
These core-tier rates are confounded with Flash’s per-call budget and may understate it: 14.9% of its core decisions are cut at the cap, and episodes with a cut turn succeed on 0.24 against 0.96 without one; the same holds on PhysicsWorld (19.2% of decisions cut over all 350 finished episodes; 0.08 against 0.34) and ChemistryWorld (20.1%; 0.15 against 0.90).
When it finishes, rule induction (0.43 of completed episodes) and pathway fault (0.67) hold it back most.
On all 1,080 core instances of the discovery worlds, the 27B succeeds on 0.358 of the trained families’ episodes and 0.394 of the held-out families’, against an oracle at 0.964 and 0.995, a headroom of about 0.60; it ends fewer than 0.05 of them invalid, so that headroom is not a format effect ( Appendix F ), though the 27B’s thinking is near its 4,096-token cap on most decisions (a mean of 3,813–4,039 tokens per decision).
In the simulator-grounded PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld families, the 27B succeeds on 0.03 and 0.18 of final instances, against 0.91 and 0.95 for the scripted oracle on the same instances ( Table 24 ).
Flash, in the core tier’s setting, is also far below the oracle on both groups.
On the instances it played (320 PhysicsWorld episodes, the first 16 of each level’s 24, and all 360 ChemistryWorld episodes), it succeeds on 0.13 and 0.33, against 0.90 and 0.95 for the oracle, paired differences of − 0.77 -0.77 [ − 0.82 -0.82 , − 0.72 -0.72 ] and − 0.63 -0.63 [ − 0.68 -0.68 , − 0.57 -0.57 ]; it is above the 27B by + 0.10 +0.10 [ + 0.06 +0.06 , + 0.14 +0.14 ] and + 0.15 +0.15 [ + 0.10 +0.10 , + 0.20 +0.20 ] on the same instances.
Most of its failures are invalid endings: 0.83 and 0.64 of its episodes end on replies without a legal action, 73% and 93% of those on two replies in a row with no content at all, as happens when a turn is cut at the per-call limit, and it solves 0.73 and 0.90 of the episodes it completes.
The GPT-6.1 Sol pilot, by contrast, solves most of both groups at one instance per family and level ( Table 7 ).

Flash’s thinking reaches the 16,384-token limit on 27% of frontier decisions, from 23% on L1 to 39% on H3.
Of the 1886 frontier episodes with a complete decision log, 1290 end on a turn answered by the thinking-off re-ask; they succeed on 0.18 (233 of 1290), against 0.69 (413 of 596) for episodes whose final decision was a full thinking turn.
Hard instances also cause long thinking, so the split is correlational and does not show how much a larger budget would recover.
We therefore read Flash’s frontier results as reasoning under a fixed per-call budget; the next paragraph measures the budget effect on one instance per family and rung.
The pilot model runs without a per-call cap of ours; over its 164 episodes the Codex CLI reported a mean of 1,872 output tokens per decision, reasoning included; token counts are not directly comparable across models, and the comparison with Flash is between a model without our cap and one under it.

困难的情况也引起长时间的思考,因此这种分化是相互关联的,并不表明一个更大的预算会恢复多少.
因此,我们把Flash的前沿结果看成是固定的逐笔预算的推理;下段衡量每个家庭的预算效果。

Flash’s capped frontier rates therefore understate it substantially, and much of the frontier tier’s difficulty for Flash is its budget; the headroom that holds is measured against the oracle. In the pilot (GPT-6.1 Sol via the Codex CLI’s “ultra” preset (server-reported reasoning effort xhigh), not the API protocol, on one final instance ( o = 0 o=0 ) per family and rung or level; Table 7 ), GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds on 71 of 84 frontier episodes (0.85, Wilson interval [0.75, 0.91]), against 32 for Flash, 7 for the 27B and 79 for the oracle on the same instances.
Against Flash capped at 16,384 tokens per call at its default effort, the difference is + 0.46 +0.46 [ + 0.36 +0.36 , + 0.57 +0.57 ], with 39 paired instances won and 0 lost, a gap that mixes model strength with Flash’s budget: against Flash at its maximum effort on the same instances it shrinks to + 0.17 +0.17 [ + 0.07 +0.07 , + 0.26 +0.26 ], about a third of it ( Section 6 ). It exceeds the 27B by + 0.76 +0.76 [ + 0.67 +0.67 , + 0.85 +0.85 ] and stays below the oracle, − 0.10 -0.10 [ − 0.18 -0.18 , − 0.01 -0.01 ], a gap that a bootstrap over families, which allows for correlated rungs of one family, does not resolve ( − 0.10 -0.10 [ − 0.19 -0.19 , 0.00 0.00 ]; Table 20 ).
It solves 12–14 of the 14 instances on each rung from H1 to L2, and on the harder rungs together its difference from the oracle is not resolved, − 0.02 -0.02 [ − 0.14 -0.14 , + 0.10 +0.10 ].
On the long-horizon rungs it is below the oracle, − 0.17 -0.17 [ − 0.29 -0.29 , − 0.07 -0.07 ], and the bootstrap over families resolves that gap ( − 0.17 -0.17 [ − 0.29 -0.29 , − 0.07 -0.07 ]); it comes mostly through L3, where it solves 8 of 14 campaigns against 13 for the oracle, − 0.36 -0.36 [ − 0.64 -0.64 , − 0.14 -0.14 ].
It also solves all 45 core-level instances of the discovery worlds, against 31 for Flash, and 17 of 20 PhysicsWorld and 15 of 15 ChemistryWorld instances, against 1 and 6 for Flash.
A stronger model at xhigh reasoning effort therefore solves most of the frontier tier, and Flash at its maximum effort solves 0.68 of the same instances; the headroom that remains is in the eight-stage campaigns and in the gap to the oracle.
With one instance per family and rung, these are pooled estimates with wide intervals, and we draw no per-family conclusion from them.

blocks.en:
Across the frontier tier, 83–90% of Flash’s failures per rung are committed wrong answers, and most of the rest end on a safety rule that the observation states ( Figure 5 b).
Only 10 of its 1,886 frontier episodes, and 18 of the 27B’s 680, end on malformed replies or the turn cap.
Because more than a quarter (27%) of Flash’s decisions are cut at its per-call budget (above), these endings describe its episodes under that budget and do not by themselves separate reasoning errors from truncation.
Rule endings concentrate in automaton learning, where a query beyond the remaining symbol allowance ends the episode, as the observation says (91 of Flash’s 141 unsafe endings).
blocks.zh:
在前沿层面,Flash每起故障中有83-90%是错误的答案,其余大部分则以观察所描述的安全规则(图5b)为结尾。
在它的1,886起前沿事件中,只有10起,在27B的680起中,只有18起以错误的答复或转弯盖结束。
因为超过四分之一(27%)的Flash的决定被削减到按要求的预算(以上),所以这些结局描述了它在该预算下的情况,并且本身并不将推理错误与截断分开。
规则的结尾集中在自动马通学习中,在剩余符号的允许性之外,一个查询结束插曲,正如观察所言(Flash141个不安全结局中的91个).

blocks.en:
On the instances both played, Flash and the 27B take almost the same number of decisions per frontier episode (20.5 and 19.6) and run similar numbers of experiments on most rungs (for example 6.3 and 5.8 on H1, 18.9 and 16.4 on L2), yet Flash succeeds 3.9 times as often.
The difference lies mostly in what each model infers from comparable evidence, under different budgets: the 27B’s thinking averages 3,877–3,999 of its 4,096 tokens per decision on the frontier tier.
Flash spends 91,000–363,000 completion tokens per frontier episode, at a mean cost of about $0.13 per episode at list prices (about $0.07 on H1 and $0.27 on L3), against $0.037 per core episode.
blocks.zh:
在所播放的节目中,Flash和27B在每次前沿剧集(20.5和19.6)中做出几乎相同的决定,并对大多数跑道进行类似的实验(例如H1、18.9和16.4的6.3和5.8,L2的实验),然而Flash成功的次数是3.9倍.
不同之处主要在于每个模型在不同预算下从可比证据中推断出的情况:27B的思维平均为3,877-3,999个,每一前沿层面的决定为4,096个令牌。
Flash每集花费91 000至363 000个完成令牌,按列表价格计算,平均成本约为每集0.13美元(H1为0.07美元,L3为0.27美元),而核心剧集为0.037美元。

The 27B succeeds on no frontier episode in eight of the 15 families, including circuit fault and heat inclusion, which the oracle solves on most of the same instances ( Tables 25 and 26 ).

blocks.en: 7  Long-Horizon Campaigns
blocks.zh: 7个长视运动

blocks.en:
The frontier tier shows that a stronger model at xhigh reasoning effort solves most single questions and short campaigns but falls well below the oracle on the eight-stage ones (8 of 14 against 13 of 14).
This section probes longer campaigns built by the same construction and admitted by the same gate.
Every result here is a probe on development instances with the pilot model (GPT-6.1 Sol via the Codex CLI’s “ultra” preset (server-reported reasoning effort xhigh), not the API protocol), eight or sixteen per rung, with the scripted oracle on the same instances, except two coupled rungs that were later also played on final instances ( Section 7.3 ); the rungs are candidates, not part of the evaluated suite.
blocks.zh:
前沿层面显示,在x高推理努力中,一个更强大的模式解决了大多数单一问题和短跑,但远远低于8个阶段的预告(14分之8对13).
本节探出由同名建筑所建造并被同名大门所接受的更长的运动.
这里的每一个结果都是对试验模型(GPT-6.1 Sol通过Codex CLI的 " 超 " 预设(服务器报告的推理努力x高),而不是API协议)的开发实例的探查,每跑8或16个,脚本的甲骨文在相同情况下都有,但两个组合的甲骨文后来也在最后实例上播放(第7.3节);一跑是候选人,不是被评价的套房的一部分。

blocks.en: 7.1  Which rungs hold a stronger model
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 哪个跑步者拥有更强大的模式

blocks.en:
Because the pilot model solves most of the frontier tier, we probed candidate rungs above it with the same model and protocol on development instances, eight per rung (sixteen for rungs near the band edge), with the scripted oracle on the same instances ( Table 8 ).
Every candidate first passed the calibration gate of Section 3.1 on two blocks of 64 development instances.
The protocol extends a rung at 3–5 of 8 by eight more instances and judges it on all sixteen.
This was done for the rungs of Table 8 and for three long campaigns of Table 9 ; four later rungs at 3–5 of 8 (heat inclusion L5, drug pipeline C2 and C3, and instrument-in-the-loop C3) were not extended and are reported at eight instances, so their status is less certain.
A rung holds the pilot model when it solves at most 0.4 of the probe instances, the target band; a rung solved on more than 0.6 is not admitted, and one between 0.4 and 0.6 holds it only partly.
The protocol also prescribes a pre-specified harder setting and a new probe for a partly-holding rung; only hidden law L4 was rebuilt that way (its 14-law version in Section 7.2 ), and the other partly-holding rungs are reported as probed.
blocks.zh:
由于试点模式解决了大部分前沿层面,我们用同样的模式和开发实例协议探测了上面的候选rags,每个rag有8个(靠近波段边缘的rags有16个),而脚本为oracle(表8)。
每个候选人首先在64个发展实例的两个街区上通过了第3.1节的校正门。
协议将8分之3至5延长8分之8,
表8和表9的三项长期运动都这样做了;4项后来在8项中的3-5项(含热量L5、毒品管道C2和C3以及仪器C3)没有延长,有8项报告,因此其状况不太确定。
一个rung在最多解决了0.4个探测器实例时,即目标波段就持有飞行员模型;一个在0.6以上上解决的rung不被承认,一个在0.4到0.6之间只持有部分.
协议还规定了预先指定的更硬的设置和对部分控股的跑道进行新的探测;只有隐藏的L4法才以这种方式被重建(其第7.2节的14-法版),另外部分控股的跑道被报告为被探测.

blocks.en:
Two long-horizon rungs of counterfeit coin (L4, 13 batches from 6 mints; L5, 20 batches from 10 mints) and an L5 campaign of hidden law (a 16-law cascade whose last answer needs constants of early laws) are admitted by the gate with the oracle at 0.80–1.00 per block, and they hold the pilot model at 0 to 2 of 8 probe instances, below the oracle on the same instances on each (counterfeit coin L4 − 0.75 -0.75 [ − 1.00 -1.00 , − 0.38 -0.38 ], L5 − 0.88 -0.88 [ − 1.00 -1.00 , − 0.63 -0.63 ]; hidden law L5 − 0.75 -0.75 [ − 1.00 -1.00 , − 0.38 -0.38 ]).
They combine an exact pooled budget, a history window of about a stage and a half, a notebook just large enough for a consolidated plan, and late questions about early facts that no later stage can re-measure.
Hidden law L4, with 12 laws, is solved on 8 of 16, above the target band; its harder version with 14 laws is in Section 7.2 .
blocks.zh:
两套长相的假币(L4,从6个薄荷中提取出13批;L5,从10个薄荷中提取出20批)和L5型隐法运动(一种16-法级级,其最后答案需要与早期法相符合)被门禁所接受,甲骨文为每块0.80-1.00;它们将试制模型按8个探测实例中的0至2个,低于甲骨文,每块相同实例的甲骨文(假币L4−0.75-0.75 [−1.00-1.00,-0.38-0.38],L5−0.88-0.88 [−1.00-1.00,-0.63];隐藏法L5−0.75-0.75 [−1.00-0.38-0.38])。
它们结合了精确的集合预算,一个大约一个半阶段的历史窗口,一个足够大,可以进行综合计划的笔记本,以及早期事实的后期问题,而后期是无法重新测量的.
隐藏的L4法律有12个法律,在目标波段上方的16分之8被解决;其更硬的版本有14个法律在第7.2节.

blocks.en:
Rungs that add hidden structure to a single question, such as factor combinations read through a drifting instrument (hidden law H4 and H5) or a stated number of faulty assay results (group testing H4 and H5, with one or two wrong results), pass the gate but are solved on 7 or 8 of 8 probe instances, so they are not admitted.
With a stated model class and a Python tool, the pilot model runs the oracle’s own exhaustive structure search and sequential design; without the tool, it designs error-correcting pools unaided.
blocks.zh:
将隐藏结构添加到单个问题中的rungs,如通过漂移仪器(隐藏定律H4和H5)读取的因子组合,或被声明的数个有错的化验结果(组测试H4和H5,结果有一两个错误),通过出门,但被解决了8个探测例中的7个或8个,因此不被承认.
使用一个已声明的模型类和一个Python工具,飞行员模型运行了神谕自己详尽的结构搜索和相继设计;没有工具,它就设计了没有帮助的校正错误的集合.

blocks.en: Existing frontier rungs can be probed the same way: rule induction’s H1 and H2 hold the pilot model only partly and its H3 holds it ( Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 现有的前沿跑道可以同样的方式进行探测:规则诱导的H1和H2只持有部分飞行员模型,其H3则持有(表8).

blocks.en:
An audit of all 35 failed probe episodes of the candidate rungs found no invalid ending; 2 malformed replies cost a turn and no budget.
The audit includes a first version of the counterfeit-coin L5 rung, which the pilot model solved on 5 of 8 probe instances, above 0.6, so it was not admitted and was redesigned as the L5 rung of Table 8 .
The 32 failures in long campaigns all used the whole pooled budget, and 29 of them wrote fewer notes than the notebook holds; the other 3 filled it only from turn 51 on, after the readings they needed had left the window.
They re-derived forgotten facts until the budget ran out or carried early constants too loosely to answer the late questions.
The 3 failures on the structure rungs are ties: the pilot model’s own record left two explanations equally likely, and it chose the wrong one.
Long campaigns that make memory and planning bind are therefore where frontier headroom remains; these probes are development-instance evidence about candidate rungs, not results on the evaluated suite.
blocks.zh:
对候选人Rungs的所有35个失败的探险事件进行审计后发现没有无效的结局;两个错误的答复花费一转而没有预算.
审计中包括了假币L5跑克的第一个版本,飞行员模型在0.6以上的8个探测例中的5个中解决了这个版本,因此没有被承认,被重新设计为表8的L5跑克.
长期竞选的32起失败都使用了整个集合预算,其中29起写的笔记比笔记本所持的要少;另外3起则是在他们需要的读数离开窗口后,从第51起才填充.
他们重新提出被遗忘的事实,直到预算用完或执行的早期常数过于松散,无法回答后期的问题.
结构上的3个失败是连结:飞行员模型自己的记录留下了两种同样可能的解释,它选择了错误的解释.
因此,使记忆力和规划力具有约束力的长期运动是前沿头室留下的地方;这些探测器是有关候选人的动态证据,而不是评价的套房的结果。

blocks.en: 7.2  Long campaigns for fourteen discovery worlds
blocks.zh: 7.2 十四个发现世界的长期运动

blocks.en:
Following that pattern, long-campaign rungs extend twelve more discovery worlds, and hidden law gains a harder L4 with 14 laws, thirteen families in all (L4 with 12 stages, 14 for hidden law, and L5 with 16, or four and five epochs where a family changes regime): one persistent hidden system, a pooled budget at the oracle’s exact need, a window of about one and a half stages, a notebook just large enough for a consolidated plan, and a final question about early facts that no later stage can re-measure, such as the original system before an announced change, a part no longer on the bench, or the first version of a program.
All 25 rungs pass the calibration gate on both development blocks, with the oracle at 0.83–1.00 and every gated shortcut, including each family’s coupling shortcut, at most 0.05.
Of the 21 rungs probed with the pilot model, 13 hold it (at most 0.4 of the probe instances), 3 hold it only partly (0.4–0.6) and 5 are not admitted (more than 0.6), so harder versions of those families are needed ( Table 9 ); probes on the 4 rungs of circuit fault and reaction network are not reported here.
blocks.zh:
按照这个模式,长跑运动又扩展了12个发现世界,隐藏法则获得了更硬的L4,拥有14个法律,总共13个家庭(L4有12个阶段,14个为隐藏法则,L5有16个时代,或者一个家庭改变制度的4个和5个时代):一个持续隐藏的系统,一个满足神谕确切需要的集合预算,一个大约一个半阶段的窗口,一个足够一个综合计划的笔记本,以及一个早期事实的最后问题,即没有后期能够重新衡量,比如宣布改变之前的原始系统,一个不再担任法官的部分,或者一个方案的第一个版本。
所有25个跑道都通过两个开发区块的校正门,甲骨文为0.83–1.00,每个入门快道,包括每个家族的接合快道最多为0.05个.

blocks.en: 7.3  Coupled multi-engine campaigns

blocks.en:
The coupled campaigns chain the suite’s simulators into one project.
A chemical-process campaign carries a compound from titration and kinetics through chromatography to a charge plan, and a drug-pipeline campaign carries a candidate from binding and potency assays through pharmacokinetics to a dose, each stage computed by the same laboratory engine and each later stage depending on numbers committed or measured earlier.
Their rungs C1–C4 pass the gate with the oracle at 0.78–1.00 per block and every gated shortcut at most 0.23, including a policy that uses only one engine and one that re-measures instead of remembering.
The pilot model solves most of the shorter rungs; the longest drug-pipeline rung (C3) holds it at 3 of 8 instances, against 6 for the oracle, a difference that eight instances do not resolve ( − 0.38 -0.38 [ − 0.88 -0.88 , + 0.25 +0.25 ]), and the four-lot chemical-process rung (C4) at 1 of 8, against 8 ( − 0.88 -0.88 [ − 1.00 -1.00 , − 0.63 -0.63 ]).
An instrument-in-the-loop campaign, in which an optics calibration feeds a spectrophotometric titration and kinetics, holds it only partly, at 4 of 8 ( − 0.50 -0.50 [ − 0.88 -0.88 , − 0.13 -0.13 ]).
These two rungs and drug pipeline C2 were probed on eight instances only ( Section 7.1 ); drug pipeline C3 and the instrument-in-the-loop rung were later also played by the pilot model, with the same rung code, on 32 final instances each, outside the evaluated suite: it solves 6 of 32 drug-pipeline campaigns, against 26 for the oracle ( − 0.63 -0.63 [ − 0.81 -0.81 , − 0.44 -0.44 ]), inside the target band, and 15 of 32 instrument-in-the-loop campaigns, against 32 ( − 0.53 -0.53 [ − 0.72 -0.72 , − 0.34 -0.34 ]), in the partly-holding band, consistent with their probe status.
All 147 failed probe episodes of the long and coupled campaigns in Table 9 ended on a committed answer, none on an invalid ending; reading 123 of them (every coupled-campaign failure and up to ten per long-campaign probe) found, as in Section 7.1 , values that left the window without being noted, or were noted without their numbers, and no format failure.
Long campaigns in which memory and planning bind are therefore where the strongest model we tested still fails; these probes show the direction of the ladder, not results on the evaluated suite.

Of Flash’s 310 L2 campaigns that reach the final commit, 107 are fully right; of the other 203, 103 first go wrong at stage 1 or 2 and 46 at the final stage.

blocks.en: 9  Training on the Worlds
blocks.zh: 9 关于世界的培训

blocks.en:
Because the rewards are exact and gated, the suite can also be used for training.
We train Concise-9B on the core tier by on-policy expert iteration and evaluate it on the core tier’s final instances, and then train the same model by online reinforcement learning on two laboratory families outside the suite ( Section 9.3 ).
blocks.zh:
由于奖品准确并有门,套房也可用于训练.
我们通过政策专家的迭代在核心层面培训简明-9B,并在核心层面的最终实例中加以评价,然后通过在线强化学习在套房外的两个实验室家庭培训同样的模式(第9.3节)。

blocks.en: 9.1  Method
blocks.zh: 9.1 方法

blocks.en:
In each round the policy plays training-split instances several times, keeps its successful episodes and fine-tunes on every decision of those episodes, its own thinking and action [ 27 , 48 , 37 ] ; malformed turns inside rewarded episodes are never targets.
Training has two phases.
The narrow phase runs three rounds on the twelve trained discovery worlds with the policy’s own episodes only, ending an episode on its first reply without a legal action, and yields Narrow-9B .
The broad phase starts from Narrow-9B , runs four rounds under the standard protocol on the 23 families that are not held out, and yields Broad-9B .
It balances the kept episodes across families, samples every level including the entry levels, and adds a capped share of successful episodes from Qwen3.8-27B and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash , rendered in the student’s chat format; it also trains on a laboratory data-analysis family outside the suite, built on the same statistics engine as the laboratory families of Section 9.3 but distinct from them and not evaluated here (the reinforcement learning of Section 9.3 starts from Concise-9B , not from Broad-9B ).
Episode counts and optimisation settings are in Appendix E ; the exact composition of the training mixture is withheld.
Training comparisons use the final instances whose hidden system does not appear among the training draws.
Four criteria for the broad phase were fixed before its evaluation, all relative to Narrow-9B except the last: fewer invalid endings; higher success on the trained discovery worlds, with a paired lower bound above zero; the same on the six families where Narrow-9B succeeded on fewer than 0.10 of episodes; and GPQA Diamond [ 31 ] within eight questions of Concise-9B , with median length at least 70% of Concise-9B ’s.
All four pass; the comparisons with Concise-9B were not pre-specified.

blocks.en: 9.3  Reinforcement learning on laboratory worlds
blocks.zh: 9.3 加强实验室世界的学习

blocks.en:
Expert iteration learns only from successful episodes, and on the suite its gains are small.
We therefore also train Concise-9B by online reinforcement learning, which learns from failed attempts as well as successful ones, on two laboratory families outside the suite, in which the agent analyses an experiment’s data with a statistics engine and commits decisions that a verifier checks.
blocks.zh:
专家迭代只从成功的剧集中学习,在套房上,其收益很小.
因此,我们还通过在线强化学习,对套房外的两个实验室家庭进行简明-9B培训,从失败尝试和成功尝试中吸取教训。 实验人员用统计引擎分析实验数据,并做出由核查人员核查的决定。

blocks.en:
A replication world gives the agent a scientist’s brief: a claimed treatment effect and the smallest difference that matters; the lab’s own experiment as a data table, with its design and a quality-control log; a budget for new experiments, priced per experimental unit and per measurement; and the lab’s decision standard.
The design states how animals, wells or donors were assigned to conditions, whether whole containers such as cages or plates were assigned, and how repeated measurements nest within units.
The standard maps the 95% interval of the treatment effect, estimated at the experimental unit [ 16 , 20 ] after exactly the exclusions that the log documents, to one of four decisions on the claim (retain, revise, reject or insufficient evidence), and it requires the final decision to rest on an independent replication; when the design does not determine the unit or an exclusion, the required decision is insufficient evidence, with a statement of what cannot be determined.
Within seven tool calls the agent analyses the table, commits a decision on the claim, sizes and runs a replication within the budget and analyses its data, and then replies with a final decision.
Its tools are those of a laboratory data-analysis assistant: table inspection, validated statistical analyses such as t tests at a chosen unit and mixed models, design checks, power calculations, a calculator, the replication experiment and the decision commit; a malformed or refused call returns its reason.
A deterministic verifier recomputes every analysis that a decision cites and accepts the episode only if each decision follows the lab’s rule from an analysis at the right unit with the documented exclusions, the replication fits the budget, and every number in the answer comes from a tool result or from the brief.
Worlds span ten design strata, from one measurement per unit and repeated measurements through treatments assigned to containers and nested labels that restart in every container to quality-control judgements, replication sizing and designs that leave the unit undetermined.
A method-comparison world, built from the same laboratory engine as the coupled campaigns of Section 7.3 , is a two-stage campaign on a hidden analyser: within a sample budget the agent chooses how many patient samples to measure with the new and a reference method and over what range, locks the analysis set with any exclusions the data justify, and commits whether the two methods are interchangeable at two medical decision points, with the bias at each, under the laboratory’s Deming-regression procedure [ 22 ] .
It has eight tool calls, and its verifier checks the commit against the hidden analyser and accepts it only if the locked data cover and settle both decision points.
Both families state their decision rules and the checks on an answer in the brief.
They are training environments outside the benchmark suite, built in the same way, with a hidden truth, a stated rule and a deterministic verifier, but not part of its calibrated tiers.

blocks.en:
Each update draws 24 worlds that no earlier update used, plays each 8 times with the current policy and takes one optimiser step on all 192 episodes.
The reward is binary and terminal, 1 when the verifier accepts the episode and 0 otherwise, without length shaping.
An episode’s advantage is its reward minus the mean reward of its group of 8 attempts at the same world [ 34 ] , without division by the group’s standard deviation [ 23 ] .
The loss clips the importance ratio [ 33 ] , bounds negative-advantage tokens with a dual clip [ 46 ] and adds a per-token penalty on the divergence from the starting model; it is divided by a fixed token count, so that an episode’s length does not change the weight of its tokens, and only the model’s own tokens are trained, not observations or tool results.
All parameters are trained at a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} for 16 updates, with sampling at temperature 1.0 without truncation and at most 4,096 tokens per turn and 16,384 per episode.
The starting model, Warm-9B , is Concise-9B after a short supervised warm-up on turns from its own episodes in training replication worlds.
Two runs start from Warm-9B with the same seed. LabRL-9B trains on 24 replication worlds per update (384 in all). MixRL-9B trains on 16 of those replication worlds per update, in the same order and with the same environment seeds, plus 8 method-comparison worlds (256 and 128 in all), so that it replaces a third of LabRL-9B ’s replication practice with method comparison.
The runs took 9.4 and 8.9 hours on one B200 GPU; Appendix E gives every setting.

The design, its checkpoints and a rule for reading the results were registered before the runs began, and the registration treats this round of training as exploratory.
Its primary comparison, MixRL-9B against LabRL-9B on a locked test set of complete laboratory workflows built from public replication data, has not been read and is not reported here.
We report the registered secondary evaluations: a held-out panel of the two training families, a benchmark of laboratory data analysis, a development set of complete workflows and GPQA Diamond.
The panel holds 30 replication worlds, three from each of the ten design strata, and 8 method-comparison worlds, four at each of two levels, drawn from the families’ development splits.
It is disjoint from training: no panel world, scenario, parent study or task content occurs among the 1,726 training-split worlds that the runs and the warm-up drew from, which include every world either run trained on ( Appendix E ).
Every system plays each panel world 8 times with the same environment and sampling seeds; success per world is the mean over its episodes, averaged over worlds, and differences are paired by world.
The checkpoints after 16 updates are the registered ones; those after 8 and 12 updates were evaluated and not selected on.
For reference, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash plays the panel through the same tools, prompts, verifier and per-turn caps, counted in the local models’ tokens, at low reasoning effort, the setting fixed before its run as its reference reading, and at its default effort (“high”), at which more of its turns reach the cap (66 capped turns on the panel, against 24 at low effort).

blocks.en: 10  Limitations
blocks.zh: 10 限制

blocks.en:
The families idealise laboratory and reasoning problems, and calibration cannot exclude shortcuts that nobody has written, nor rule out that a route below the gate still shapes training ( Section 9.2 ).
The classic-puzzle families measure experimental reasoning in a pure form, not domain science; the suite’s simulator-grounded science is in PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld, whose simulators have the known limits recorded in their datasheets.
The frontier tier was tuned against the one API model it reports: its target band was a range of Flash success, read from screens of Flash on final instances, and its action parsers, part of its campaign wording, one budget display and the re-ask after a cut turn were revised after Flash’s first screen of those instances, which were then played again ( Section 3.2 ). Selecting rungs against Flash biases Flash’s absolute rates on that tier downwards and favours other models in comparisons with Flash; confirming Flash’s frontier rates on an untouched block of final instances is future work.
Flash’s tier-wide results use the provider’s default reasoning effort and 16,384 tokens per call and understate it: on the 84 o = 0 o=0 frontier instances, one per family and rung, its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call raises its successes from 32 to 57, below the pilot model’s 71 and the oracle’s 79, and its maximum-effort rates on the other frontier instances and on the core tier are not measured. The headroom we claim is against the oracle, with the pilot model at xhigh effort as the strongest system tested; it lies mainly in the eight-stage campaigns, where neither that model nor Flash at maximum effort solves more than 8 of 14, and, in development-instance probes, in the longer campaigns.
The candidate rungs above the frontier tier were probed on development instances with one model at xhigh effort and eight or sixteen instances per rung, and two of them also on 32 final instances; four rungs at 3–5 of 8 were not extended to sixteen as the probe protocol prescribes, and of the partly-holding rungs only one was rebuilt harder, so the probes show a direction for the ladder rather than results on the evaluated suite.
Flash’s PhysicsWorld run covers the first 16 of 24 final instances per level, paired with the other systems on those instances.
The pilot plays one final instance per family and rung through the Codex CLI rather than the API protocol, without our per-call token cap, so its rates are pooled estimates with wide intervals that support no per-family claim.
The tier’s main results rest on one API model at up to 24 instances per family and rung (19 on H3, 18 on L3), one locally run model at 8, whose thinking is near its 4,096-token cap on most decisions (a mean of 3,813–4,039 tokens per decision), and a one-instance pilot of a third model; a broader model comparison is a natural next step.
Scores depend on the evaluation budgets: 4,096 thinking tokens per decision for the local models and 16,384 tokens per call for the API model, which reaches that limit on 27% of its frontier decisions; episodes that end on a re-asked turn succeed far less often, and its maximum effort with a larger budget raises Flash’s success on one instance per family and rung from 0.38 to 0.68 ( Section 6 ), so much of the frontier tier’s difficulty for Flash is a budget effect.

The training study is one model and one run.
Its intervals cover the sampling of evaluation episodes, not variation across training runs, and its two phases differ in family mix, teacher share, protocol and number of rounds, so their separate contributions are not identified.
GPQA Diamond with one response per question detects a large loss of general reasoning but not a small one, and transfer rests on three held-out discovery worlds, two of which improve in point estimate, and one held-out PhysicsWorld family.

The reinforcement-learning study ( Section 9.3 ) trains one seed per run, and its intervals describe the panel’s worlds and episodes, not variation across training runs.
Its panel holds 30 and 8 held-out worlds of the two training families, so it measures learning within those families; the registered test on locked real-data workflows has not been read, and the broader evaluations use development splits with one attempt per item, on which the gain carries over through more reliable finishing, with accuracy on the items both models answered unchanged, while Flash stays ahead.
The laboratory families are training environments outside the benchmark suite, built in the same way but not part of its calibrated tiers, and we make no claim that the trained models learned to identify the experimental unit from the stated design; the locked workflow test addresses that.
Flash’s reference setting on the panel is its low reasoning effort; at its default effort its success is lower on both families (0.371 and 0.094), and the comparison with it is not part of the registration. Both panel readings hold Flash to the 9B’s per-turn and per-episode token caps, which bind it more at its default effort, so the panel understates it; with up to 24,000 tokens per call it leads on the broader evaluations. The registered checkpoint of LabRL-9B fails one registered guard of the broader benchmark (R).

blocks.en: 11  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Openhagen Worlds, a suite of calibrated, procedurally generated discovery environments (with finite truth spaces in some families) in which hidden truths are checked exactly, every scoring rule is published and a gate at every level holds the naive policy to at most 0.25 and every gated shortcut to at most 0.35 of development instances while the oracle succeeds on at least 0.75.
Its core tier separates the local models from the oracle and approaches saturation for frontier models; on both tiers, Flash’s tier-wide results are measured under a capped per-call budget and understate it: at its maximum effort it solves 57 rather than 32 of 84 frontier instances, one per family and rung, still below the oracle’s 79.
In a pilot, a stronger model at xhigh reasoning effort solves most of the frontier tier, and Flash at its maximum effort closes about two thirds of the gap to it (57 against 71 of 84; 7 against 8 of 14 on the eight-stage campaigns), leaving headroom mainly in those campaigns and in the gap to the oracle, so the ladder has to keep climbing; development-instance probes show that most longer campaigns admitted by the same gate, which make memory and planning bind, hold that model where added hidden structure does not.
Under Flash’s per-call cap, failed episodes mostly end on wrong answers rather than malformed output, and campaign errors start early and compound.
On-policy expert iteration on the suite gives a 9B model modest gains, resolved on the trained families and carried by two of three held-out families, without a detectable loss on GPQA Diamond, and its episode records let a training filter check how each answer was reached.
In a separate study, online reinforcement learning on laboratory worlds outside the suite raises a 9B model’s success on held-out replication worlds from 0.221 to 0.721 in one training run, above Flash held to the 9B’s token caps but not above Flash at a larger budget on broader laboratory analysis (0.849 against 0.605), and its registered checkpoint fails one registered guard.
Beyond single worlds, we have composed the families into multi-laboratory campaigns, in which samples and measurements pass between laboratories, runs fail or drift, and requests change partway through; training runs that included these campaigns were accompanied by gains on held-out laboratory tasks, and we will report a controlled comparison separately.
We hope the suite serves as a calibrated measure of experimental reasoning; we plan to extend the frontier tier’s evaluation to more models and to the full set of withheld instances at maximum-effort budgets, to admit the longer campaigns as rungs of the evaluated suite, and to read the locked workflow test of the laboratory runs and repeat them over training seeds.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Openhagen Worlds, 一套经过校正、程序化生成的发现环境(有些家庭有有限的真理空间), 其中对隐藏的真理进行精确的检查, 公布每个评分规则,
其核心层次将当地模型与甲骨文和前沿模型的饱和度方法区分开来;在两个层次上,Flash的分层次结果都是在每次调用预算的上限下衡量的,并且低估了它:在84个前沿案例中,它以最大努力解决了57个而不是32个,每个家庭一个,仍然低于甲骨文的79个。
在试点中,X高推理努力的更强模型解决了大部分前沿层面,而Flash在最大努力中将大约三分之二的差距拉近(84场中的57场对71场;14场中的7场对8场对8场),将主室主要留在了这些运动中,并把缺口拉到甲骨文上,因此梯子必须不断攀登;开发-内置探测器显示,同一大门所承认的大部分更长的运动,使记忆和规划具有约束性,在增加的隐藏结构没有存在的地方,保持了这个模型.
在Flash的每个调用上限下,失败的事件大多以错误的答案而不是错误的输出而结束,竞选错误会从早期开始并复合.
套房上的政策专家迭接获得了9B模式的微小收益,解决了受培训家庭的问题,由被搁置的3个家庭中的2个家庭承担,GPQA Diamond上没有可被察觉的损失,其插曲记录让培训过滤器检查每个答案是如何得到的.
在另外一项研究中,关于套房外实验室世界的在线强化学习使9B模型在被搁置的复制世界上的成功率从0.221提高到了0.721,在一次训练中,Flash在9B的标志盖上被扣住,但在更广泛的实验室分析预算(0.849对0.605)上则不在Flash上被扣住,其注册检查站未能有一个注册警卫。
除了单一世界之外,我们还使这些家庭组成了多实验室运动,其中样品和测量在实验室之间传递、运行失败或漂移,并请求进行局部改变;包括这些运动在内的培训活动在完成被搁置的实验室任务的同时有所进展,我们将单独报告一个有控制的比较。
我们希望这套套套装能够作为实验推理的校正度量;我们计划将前沿评估扩展到更多的模型,并扩展到在最大努力预算中被扣的全套实例,承认长期运动是被评估套装的套装,并阅读实验室运行的锁定工作流程测试,并在培训种子上重复。

blocks.en: Availability
blocks.zh: 可用性

blocks.en:
Openhagen Worlds, including the datasheet of every family and the frontier tier, is available to research and industry partners under licence; the multi-laboratory campaigns are available on the same terms.
A hosted evaluation service ( https://eval.openhagen.ai ; its front page and https://eval.openhagen.ai/evaluation document the API, and access tokens are issued on request to hello@openhagen.ai ) plays exactly the core tier’s 2,208 final instances with the same family code and protocol, and reveals only the observation, reward, termination and success, so any model can be scored on the instances behind Tables 10 and 23 without access to the generators.
Played through the service, the scripted oracle and naive policy reproduce all 30 of their per-family final-instance rates on the discovery worlds.
A frozen sample of 48 development-split instances from two families, trace debugging and causal intervention, each with its observation, hidden truth and a verified gold answer, and one scripted-oracle episode per family, is released with this report under CC BY 4.0, as ancillary files of this preprint and at https://eval.openhagen.ai/sample/ ( Appendix A ).
The keys of the final instances and of the protected-structure filter are held by Openhagen and never distributed.

blocks.en:
A second audit re-runs the calibration, determinism and shortcut checks on the distributed build of the suite rather than the research code.
Replaying the original calibration instances reproduces 88 of the 90 oracle and naive entries of the fifteen discovery worlds exactly, and the other two differ by a single instance in a simulator-backed family, through floating-point differences between processor architectures.
On a separate development split, sixteen families pass every gate at every audited level, 88 family levels in all with entry and harder levels included; 50 of those were run on both macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 and pass on both, and every update replays each previously audited level byte for byte.
On the ten PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld families the audit passes 34 of 35 levels; the exception is a rigid-body level whose naive policy reached 17 of 64 on that split, one episode above the gate, and which passes on both calibration blocks.
The frontier rungs are admitted on the machine that plays their final instances.
blocks.zh:
第二次审计重新对套房的分布式建筑而非研究代码进行校准,定型和快捷键检查.
重放原始的校正实例,完全照搬了15个发现世界90个甲骨文和天真条目中的88个,另外2个则通过处理器架构之间的浮点差异,在一个模拟器后置家族中以单个实例不同.
在单独的开发分裂中,16个家庭在每个审计级别通过每个大门,88个家庭级别都包含入门和更硬的关卡;其中50个在macOS arm64和Linux x86_64上运行,并传递这两个门卡,每个更新都重复了以前审计过的每个字节。
在10个物理世界和化学世界家族中,审计超过35个等级中的34个等级;例外是刚性的身体等级,其天真政策在64个等级中达到17个等级,在大门上方有一集,它通过两个校正区块。
边疆队在进行最后比赛的机器上被接纳。

blocks.en:
Most families compute their readings exactly: nodal analysis of resistor networks, complex impedance, closed-form kinetics checked against a numerical ODE solver, an exact discretisation of a control loop with dead time, Boolean reachability in signalling networks, charge-balance equilibria, modal analysis, and interpreters for programs and machines.
Heat inclusion’s finite-volume solver agrees with a finite-element reference (scikit-fem; 15 ) to within 19 mK over all 2,916 candidate inclusions, under a quarter of the noise at every core level (at least 80 mK), and the rigid-body integrator agrees with MuJoCo [ 41 ] to within 0.04 ∘ 0.04^{\circ} on 128 fixed release comparisons.
The hydraulic solver implements the global-gradient method of EPANET [ 32 ] ; pathway fault simulates curated BioModels kinetic models [ 25 ] with libRoadRunner [ 43 ] ; and structure elucidation draws from an isomer bank enumerated with RDKit [ 30 ] .
External simulators run out of process in pinned environments, all randomness is seeded, and every admission run records a replay digest over the truth, every prompt, every oracle action and the return.
blocks.zh:
大多数家庭精确计算其读取:电阻器网络的节点分析、复杂的阻滞、与数字ODE解析器对照的闭式动能、与死活时间有关的控制回路的精确磁盘化、信号网络中的布尔可达性、电荷平衡等、模式分析以及程序和机器的翻译。
包含热量的有限解析器同意在19克以内(skikt-fem; 15克以内,
液压溶解器采用EPANET[32]的全球分级法;路径断层用libRoadRunner[43]模拟了被解析的生物模型[25];结构解析取自RDKit所列举的同分异构体库[30]。
外部模拟器在被钉住的环境中耗尽了过程,所有随机性被播下种子,每一次录入运行都记录出一个重播文摘在真理上,每一个即时,每一个神谕动作和回回.

blocks.en:
Every distributed data file carries a canary string, every observation an instance hash, and a deduplication tool checks a training corpus against a split.
The exact-execution generator rejects every program whose structure matches a protected program-execution benchmark; the protected list exists only as keyed digests under a key that is never distributed, so it cannot be enumerated from the code, and a copy of the generator without the key draws from a different instance space.
Comparing 3,000 training truths with 64 development truths per level finds no repeated truth in 22 families.
Four families draw their truths from a finite bank by construction and show one opening observation per level, so what can be learned there is the mapping from observations to answers; in pathway fault, the published kinetic models recur across splits, so its splits separate instances, not models.
blocks.zh:
每个分布的数据文件都带有金丝雀弦,每个观察一个实例散列,一个分解工具检查一个训练团与一个分解.
精确执行生成器拒绝每一个其结构与受保护的程序执行基准相匹配的程序;被保护列表仅作为密钥下的密钥摘要存在,而密钥从未分布,因此无法从代码中列出,没有密钥的生成器副本取自不同的实例空间.
将3 000起培训真相与每起发展真相64起比较,发现22个家庭没有重复的事实。
四个家庭通过建筑从有限的银行中汲取真相,并显示每层一个开口观察,所以可以学到的就是从观测到答案的绘图;在路径断层中,公布的动能模型在分裂间会相继发生,因此它的分裂是不同的实例,而不是模型.

blocks.en:
Every evaluation of Concise-9B , Narrow-9B , Broad-9B and Qwen3.8-27B uses thinking on, a 4,096-token thinking cap per decision with a forced close, temperature 1.0, top- p p 0.95 and top- k k 20, under the protocol of Section 3.3 .
After a forced close, the answer budget is just large enough for the answer, so that the model cannot keep reasoning past the thinking cap.
blocks.zh:
每一次对Concise-9B,Narrow-9B,Broad-9B和Quen3.8-27B的评价都采用思考方式,每决定一个4,096-token的思考上限,并强制关闭,温度为1.0,上-p 0.95和上-k 20,根据3.3节的协议.
在强制关闭后,答案预算只是足够大的答案,因此模型不能让推理一直超越思维上限.

blocks.en:
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the snapshot V4.1-Flash-1017, served under the deepseek-flash API name since 17 October 2026; every run reported here used it with thinking on, and the default-effort suite runs used a limit of 16,384 tokens per call. The maximum-effort comparison of Table 6 used reasoning effort “max” with up to 393,216 tokens per call and no re-ask ( Table 4 ).
On the core tier, including PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld, a turn cut at the limit returns no action, and two such turns in a row end the episode, as for any two replies without a legal action.
On the frontier tier a cut turn gets one re-ask of the same messages with thinking off and the episode’s answer budget, asking for the action line only, and the reply counts as the turn’s action; the re-ask carries the cut turn’s reasoning, up to its last 90,000 characters.
Its runs on the laboratory worlds of Section 9.3 use the same API name with the effort settings and caps given in Appendix E , not the 16,384-token limit above.
Every response is logged with its exact messages, so every episode can be replayed without new calls.
blocks.zh:
深层搜索 V4.1 Flash是快照V4.1-Flash-1017,自2026年10月17日起服务于深视-flash API名下;这里所报道的每一跑都用它来思考,而默认-effort套跑则使用每个呼叫16,384个令牌的限制. 表6的最大功率比较使用了推理努力“最大”法,每次调用最多393 216个令牌,不重复询问(表4)。
在核心层面,包括"物理世界"和"化学世界"(Chemistry World),极限的转弯不返回任何动作,连续两个这样的转弯结束剧集,如同任何两个没有法律诉讼的答复一样.
在前沿层面,一个切入的转弯会得到一个相同的消息的重覆,其中包含思考和剧集的答案预算,只要求行动线,而回答则算作转弯;重回的转弯会包含切入的推理,直到最后的9万个字符.
它在第9.3节的实验室世界运行时使用相同的API名称,其努力设置和上限载于附录E,而不是上面的16,384个托肯限制.
每个回复都用其准确的信息记录下来,因此每集都可以被重播而无需新打来.

blocks.en:
The pilot (GPT-6.1 Sol via the Codex CLI’s “ultra” preset (server-reported reasoning effort xhigh), not the API protocol) plays the instance with ordinal o = 0 o=0 of every family and frontier rung, and of every core level of the discovery worlds, PhysicsWorld and ChemistryWorld.
Each decision is one stateless call that carries exactly the messages of the API protocol; the observation already contains the history (on L3, its window and notebook), every tool is disabled except the collaboration (sub-agent) tools that this CLI build offers regardless, which no stored call record shows in use, and the model’s final message is passed to the action parser unchanged.
The output length is not ours to cap, so the frontier re-ask does not apply.
The pilot runs the same evaluation code on a second machine of a different processor architecture. A replay feeds a recorded episode’s actions to the environment again; its outcome matches when it gives the same return (and, for Flash, the same ending). On that machine, 129 of 130 replayed Flash episodes and 80 of 80 replayed 27B episodes match (49 of Flash’s are byte-identical at every turn; the others differ only after a model-written Python run, whose printed output differs in its last digits across architectures). The one that does not match is a pathway-fault L1 instance that draws a different hidden model, as the hosted-service paragraph below describes for that family, and is excluded from every pilot comparison. Two rigid-body instances show small numerical differences in some joint readings and are kept.
The oracle results in Table 7 were played on that machine.

飞行员(GPT-6.1) Sol通过 Codex CLI 的“超”预设(服务器报告的推理努力x高),而不是 API 协议(API protocol),在每一个家族和边疆区,以及发现世界、物理世界和化学世界的每一个核心层次上,都以正数o=0=0为例。
每一个决定都是一个无国籍的呼叫,它完全携带API协议的信息;观察已经包含历史(在L3,它的窗口和笔记本上),除了这个CLI所建立的协作(副代理)工具之外,每个工具都被禁用,不管这些工具在使用中没有存储的呼叫记录,模型的最终消息被传递给动作解析器,没有改变.

blocks.en:
Both phases fine-tune all parameters for one epoch per round on every decision of the kept episodes ( Table 21 ), at a learning rate of order 10 − 6 10^{-6} with batches of a few dozen sequences (exact values withheld).
Rollouts use a 4,096-token thinking cap per decision; the narrow phase samples at temperature 1.0 without top- p p /top- k k truncation, and the broad phase samples like the evaluation.
In the broad phase’s training rollouts, pooled over all trained families, invalid endings fell from 0.118 in the first round to 0.026, 0.020 and 0.017.

blocks.en:
The four criteria of Section 9.1 were fixed before the broad phase’s evaluation: (i) fewer invalid endings than Narrow-9B over all final instances; (ii) higher success than Narrow-9B on the twelve trained discovery worlds, with a paired lower bound above zero; (iii) the same on the six families where Narrow-9B succeeded on fewer than 0.10; and (iv) GPQA Diamond within eight questions of Concise-9B , with median length at least 70% of Concise-9B ’s.
All four pass: (i) − 0.043 -0.043 [ − 0.054 -0.054 , − 0.032 -0.032 ]; (ii) + 0.045 +0.045 [ + 0.019 +0.019 , + 0.072 +0.072 ]; (iii) + 0.026 +0.026 [ + 0.007 +0.007 , + 0.046 +0.046 ], mostly control plant; (iv) 156 against 155.

Before each step the trainer recomputes the log-probability of every sampled token and rejects the batch if it differs from the sampler’s beyond fixed tolerances; a token whose two log-probabilities differ by more than 5 nats is dropped from the loss, which happened to 2 tokens in all, both in MixRL-9B .
Every update of both runs committed, no episode was excluded, and gradient clipping did not bind in any update.
